history.summary: Large outlier unit at a leasehold project 100m from Potong Pasir MRT; the headline PSF looks cheap but it is mostly a size artifact, and the $3.1M quantum hurts exit liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,309 psf sits well below the project's ~$1,774 psf recent-transaction average (range $1,728-1,799 in last 12 months), which the algo reads as -25.8% vs cohort and -28.4% age-adjusted. But the project's normal floorplans are 883-1,399 sqft (2-3BR); this 2,368 sqft 4-bed is an outlier combined/penthouse-type unit with psf_cohort_txns=0, and large units structurally trade at a deep PSF discount, so the discount is largely a size effect rather than a true bargain. A competing same-size 2,368 sqft unit lists at $3.22M ($1,358 psf), so this one only marginally undercuts. The strong, verified catalyst (100m to Potong Pasir NE10, North-East D13 OCR/RCR region with the best realized forward returns) supports the location, but the $3.1M quantum and thin same-size resale/rental market make exit and yield difficult on a 5-7yr hold.
red_flags: 2,368 sqft 4-bed is an outlier vs project's normal 883-1,399 sqft range (likely combined unit or sqft anomaly) - psf_cohort_txns=0, no like-for-like comps
Low PSF is mostly a large-unit size effect, not genuine cheapness; the -25.8% cohort signal cannot be trusted with zero same-size transactions
$3.1M quantum narrows the buyer/tenant pool, weakening resale liquidity and gross yield
99-yr leasehold from 2007 - ~80 years left, lease decay accelerating over a 5-7yr hold
catalysts: 100m to Potong Pasir MRT (NE10) - top-tier transit access
North-East D13 (Toa Payoh/Potong Pasir fringe) sits in the OCR/RCR band with the strongest realized forward appreciation
Low absolute PSF vs project median offers some cushion if the large layout suits an own-stay/multi-gen buyer
